notes.title: It's easier to change difficulty with this new update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Surprise, everyone! It's a new [i]malViolence[/i] update.[/h2]

We've received a few comments about making the difficulty change more obvious - so we've done just that.

If you're playing [i]malViolence[/i] for the first time, [b]the difficulty selection will now be in the pop-up menu that appears just before the game starts![/b]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1075062811459321946/1113500937034670170/image.png[/img]

[b]Additionally, with saves made after this update, there will be a difficulty indicator in the top-right corner of your save screenshot. [/b]That way, you can track the difficulty of your save files.

[b]However, saves made before this update won't have this indicator. [/b] Please keep this in mind!

Also... I don't know if I mentioned this, but I removed the [i]malViolence[/i] puzzle guide from the game's folder. 

[b]This was for two reasons: [/b]

[list]
[*] a) People struggled to find it
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2977721903 ]b) The lovely wBrianthepyro turned the entire document into an official Steam Guide![/url]
[/list]
Please thank Brian for his hard work - he deserves a round of applause and more!

[url=https://madocallie.itch.io/malviolence]If you still want a copy of the official guide for yourself, you can download it from here.[/url]

Anyway, that's all for now! Please enjoy this new update...

[strike](Also I made some hitbox fixes, so it should be easier for you to find certain items in Room 3 now)[/strike]
